svg.title: Shipping lanes between Russian and Iranian ports
svg.desc: Map of the Caspian Sea with the shores of its five littoral states. On the Russian side are the ports of Astrakhan, Olya and Makhachkala and the naval base at Kaspiysk; on the Iranian side, Bandar-e Anzali, Nowshahr and Amirabad. The lines show the sea routes ships run between these ports without ever leaving the sea.
